text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: New Year's Day...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many students have gone home for the
winter
break. With them gone for the
next few days, the
academy has been
quiet and still, like a fire's
gone out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the change of pace, I can't
afford to just
lounge around. This year,
my trainee's entering
her all-important
classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I review last year's race results and
training logs
before carefully writing up
a plan for this year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After all, Admire Vega will be facing the

incredibly trying Classic Triple Crown
tour. No
amount of preparation can be
enough for this
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, I enthusiastically
press on with
my tasks, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gurgle...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite making sure to bring everything
I need
for work, I completely forgot to
prepare any
food. I'm also entirely out of
ready-to-eat meals
and snacks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With fingers crossed, I visit the nearby
shopping
district, only to find that
everywhere is closed
due to the holiday.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Happy New Year.
choice_data_list: あれ、アヤベ！あけましておめでとう！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega returns my greeting. She's
wearing a
tracksuit, and her cheeks are
slightly flushed—it
appears she's already
started training diligently.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes, I ran out of sports drink powder...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's a big help... always.
choice_data_list: コンビニは元日も開いてて助かるよな
コンビニは元日も開いてて助かるよね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her throw out the word "always,"
I
suddenly realize she likely doesn't
return home,
even during the holidays.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has her reasons, which I certainly
can't
change, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to finish my shopping. See
you...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as we bumped into each other, I
offer to
help finish her shopping while I
get my lunch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her tenacious refusal, I convince
her to
let an adult handle things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I decide to throw in a little extra
while I'm
at it. But what to choose?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What's this?
choice_data_list: 元気が出そうなホットスナック
リラックスできそうなインスタントスープ
頭が冴えそうなスイーツ

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Well, thanks.
choice_data_list: せっかくだから。今日も寒いし

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega starts to eat the piping hot
meat
bun, so I take a bite out of the one
I got for
myself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Are you okay? Is it too hot for you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine... I don't have a problem with hot
food.
choice_data_list: か、かも……アヤベは平気なのか？
か、かも……アヤベは平気なの？

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
They say you should eat without letting
the food
touch the tip of your tongue. I
don't know if it
works, though...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a bit, I enjoy my delicious meat
bun.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It isn't one with any extra stuff in it, is it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: A what?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Never mind... Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's cold out.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(And dreary... I guess because the others
aren't
here.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah, that reminds me...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ahh...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...So warm.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh, a dessert?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You... really didn't need to.
choice_data_list: 『ふわふわバニラスフレ』だよ

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Phew!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (So soft...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whirrrr... Whirrrr...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I just have to wait for the laundry
to dry.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Fluffy...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Munch.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (It is fluffy!)
